sections.title: Set off and carry forward of losses computed in respect of specified business.

subsections.text_before_clauses: Any loss, computed in respect of a specified business, referred to in section 46, shall be set off only against profits and gains of another specified business.

Where for any tax year, loss computed in respect of a specified business cannot be wholly set off under sub-section (1), so much of the loss not so set off or the whole loss, as the case may be, shall be carried forward to the following tax year and—
